facts.text: Caroline attended a pride parade a few weeks before 15 July 2023 and described it as a top memory.

evidence.quote: One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.
It was amazing! I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me. It's definitely a top memory.

facts.text: Caroline participated in the pride parade and felt accepted and happy being around people who celebrated her identity.

evidence.quote: I felt so accepted and happy, just being around people who accepted and celebrated me.

facts.text: Caroline expressed feeling proud and grateful during a ceremony where she was surrounded by love and acceptance.

evidence.quote: I felt so proud and grateful - the vibes were amazing and it was comforting to know I'm not alone and have a great community around me.
